protocol.analysis_unit: independent source training seed; all 100 brains averaged within seed
protocol.inference: Exploratory descriptive analyses only; 20000 paired bootstrap resamples and pointwise 95% intervals, no confirmatory tests.
protocol.limitations: Local derivatives and single-decision clamps do not estimate fitness effects. Some clamps leave naturally observed input support. Observed states differ between policies. Hidden unit identities are network-specific; activation is not semantic understanding. Fixed speed ignores throttle. Nearest-food targets may switch; trajectories and initial food are illustrative, not planning evidence.
